name: Metal Detector
description: A device that leads you to buried treasure.
coin.yoba-copper.name: Yoba Copper Coin
coin.yoba-copper.description: A rare copper coin stamped with Yoba's mark.
coin.yoba-silver.name: Yoba Silver Coin
coin.yoba-silver.description: A rare silver coin stamped with Yoba's mark.
coin.yoba-gold.name: Yoba Gold Coin
coin.yoba-gold.description: A rare gold coin stamped with Yoba's mark.
coin.yoba-iridium.name: Yoba Iridium Coin
coin.yoba-iridium.description: A rare iridium coin stamped with Yoba's mark.
config.mod-enabled.name: Mod Enabled
config.mod-enabled.tooltip: Enable Coin Collector Redux. Restart the game after changing this option.
config.debug-logging.name: Debug Logging
config.debug-logging.tooltip: Log extra diagnostic messages for troubleshooting.
config.require-detector.name: Require Metal Detector
config.require-detector.tooltip: Only play detector blips while holding a recognized metal detector.
config.require-swing.name: Require Metal Detector Swing
config.require-swing.tooltip: Only ping when using the held detector instead of polling automatically.
config.blip-volume.name: Blip Audio Volume
config.pitch.name: Increase Pitch Near Coins
config.pitch.tooltip: Increase blip pitch as the player gets closer to a coin.
config.poll-seconds.name: Seconds Per Poll
config.map-chance.name: Map Has Coins Chance
config.map-chance.tooltip: Daily chance each outdoor map receives coin spots.
config.min-coins.name: Minimum Coins Per Map
config.min-coins.tooltip: Minimum generated coin spots on a valid map.
config.max-coins.name: Maximum Coins Per Map
config.max-coins.tooltip: Maximum generated coin spots on a valid map before luck bonus.
config.luck-factor.name: Luck Factor
config.luck-factor.tooltip: How much player luck can increase maximum generated coins.
config.max-distance.name: Max Pixel Ping Distance
config.max-distance.tooltip: Maximum pixel distance for detector pings. Use 0 for unlimited.
config.coin-price.name: {{coinName}} Price
config.coin-price.tooltip: Sell price in gold for {{coinName}}. Enter a whole number of 0 or higher.
config.indicator-enabled.name: Enable Indicator
config.indicator-enabled.tooltip: Show a directional projectile indicator toward the nearest coin.
config.indicator-sprite.name: Indicator Sprite
config.indicator-sprite.tooltip: Projectile sprite index used by the detector indicator.
config.indicator-length.name: Indicator Length
config.indicator-length.tooltip: Maximum indicator travel distance in tiles.
config.indicator-speed.name: Indicator Speed
config.indicator-speed.tooltip: Speed multiplier for the directional indicator.
